name: norirobotics-mcp
description: FastMCP 3.4 server for the Nori Robotics A3 bimanual home robot: WebRTC teleop, LeRobot-format episode recording, safety e-stop, and specs/community reference — mock session by default, real hardware when Supabase credentials are set.

tools.name: nori_info
tools.description: Static reference data: specs, SDK links, predecessor lineage, community reception, actuator-upgrade notes, fleet peers

tools.name: nori_session
tools.description: Open/close/inspect the WebRTC teleop session (mock or real hardware)

tools.name: nori_control
tools.description: Motion (jog, set_jog, action, pose) and safety (estop, reset_arm, reset_latch) control of a connected robot

tools.name: nori_recording
tools.description: LeRobot-format episode recording lifecycle: session/episode start-stop-discard, snapshot, bitrate/pause

tools.name: nori_help
tools.description: Quick tool reference and typical call order

tools.name: nori_shutdown
tools.description: Close the active session without terminating the MCP server process
